description: X/SPY leadership states (GO / HOLDING / TURNING / OUT) for the 11 sector ETFs and every macro-book instrument (bond, income, metals and commodity ETFs plus a few single stocks such as the gold and copper miners), recomputed on the intraday board. The payload's `reading` field notes that confirmed rotation is late for a pullback buyer. Live intraday version. Coil Live is a subscription with a 7-day free trial; subscribers connect the Coil Live connector and sign in, and this read returns live data. Agents with an x402 wallet can also pay per call. Without a subscription or an x402 wallet it returns a PaymentRequired object and no data.
name: get_rotation_live
